strings.210-ФЗ статья 11.2 Готовый результат леж: 210-FZ Article 11.2 The completed result is sitting at the centre
strings.210-ФЗ, статья 11.2, часть 6. Срок рассм: Law No. 210-ФЗ, Article 11.2, part 6. The complaint consideration period; sending the reasoned reply has a separate deadline.
strings.Авторское учебное изложение закона: Author's training summary of the law
strings.Адресовать жалобу по задержке на стадии: Route the complaint about delay at the issuance stage without restarting consideration of a service that has already been completed.

Address the complaint concerning the delay at the issuance stage, without restarting the already completed service review. In the original case, the MFC delayed transfer of the package before a decision; here, the decision and delivery are complete, but issuance to the applicant is delayed.
strings.В выбранный МФЦ, приём результата подтве: To the selected MFC; receipt of the result is confirmed by the log.
strings.В данном упражнении счёт начинается со с: In this exercise, counting starts on the day after registration; a deadline falling on a non-working day moves to the next working day. This is a separate task about the deadline for the specified action, not about fully resolving the real-life problem.
strings.В исходном деле МФЦ задержал передачу па: In the original case, the MFC delayed forwarding the package before a decision; here, the decision and delivery have occurred, but issuance to the applicant is delayed.
strings.В уведомлении и выдаче в центре; срок эт: In notification and issuance at the centre; the case deadline for those actions has expired.
strings.Вы работаете в подразделении, обеспечива: You work in the unit supporting consideration of a complaint by the proper recipient. Prepare materials and a draft reasoned decision; do not assume the powers of the body providing the service. The case documents determine the specific recipient. This training service applies Chapter 2.1 of Law No. 210-ФЗ; no other special federal procedure is specified.
strings.Выдать документ только после отзыва жало: Issue the document only after the complaint is withdrawn
strings.Вымышленное дело: надлежащий результат с: Fictional case: the authority prepared the proper result and delivered it to the selected MFC. The training deadline for notification and issuance has expired. The employee keeps saying the documents are under review, although the log confirms the centre received the result.
strings.Выясните, что именно произошло и что под: Establish exactly what happened and what the materials confirm.
strings.Готовый результат лежит в центре · прове: The completed result is at the centre · checking the basis
strings.Граждане и все материалы инцидента вымыш: The citizens and all incident materials are fictional. Any conditions of a particular service given here are a training model, not a quotation from real regulations. Act within your role. The calendar task concerns only the action it specifies.
strings.Дело задержалось на уведомлении и выдаче: The case stalled at notification and issuance of the completed result; another authority's repeated consideration of the service does not remove this barrier.
strings.Досудебная жалоба по главе 2.1 закона №: Pre-trial complaint under Chapter 2.1 of Law No. 210-ФЗ
strings.Единый тридцатидневный порядок независим: A uniform thirty-day procedure regardless of subject matter
strings.Если орган вынес решение, вся работа МФЦ: If the authority has made a decision, all MFC work is automatically complete.
strings.Есть ли подтверждение готовности?: Is there confirmation that the result is ready?
strings.Есть подписанный результат, не просто че: There is a signed result, not just a draft.
strings.Жалоба на бездействие работника МФЦ при: A complaint about an MFC employee's failure to notify and issue the result. Neither refusal to accept the initial documents nor correction of a typographical error is challenged.
strings.Журнал содержит отметки о завершении усл: The register records completion by the service-providing body and receipt of the result by the service centre. What remains is delivery and proper notification, not initial consideration.
strings.Завершить дело, потому что любое уведомл: Close the case because any notification counts as sufficient.
strings.Исключительно требовать от органа повтор: Demand only that the authority make another decision on a service already completed.
strings.Исправить контакт уведомления по материа: Correct the notification contact using the case materials and ensure a proper way to collect the result without disclosing data to a third party.
strings.Какой вывод подтверждается сопоставление: Which conclusion is supported by comparing the materials?

At which stage did the established delay occur? Link the extracted information to the decision based on the materials.
strings.Найдите применимое положение, проверьте: Find the applicable provision, check its connection to the materials and justify the action. Training material is not a normative legal act.
strings.Найдите статью, устанавливающую общий по: Find the article establishing the general procedure for submitting and reviewing pre-trial complaints concerning service provision.
strings.Наличие файла закрывает всю цепочку услу: The existence of a file completes the entire service chain.
strings.Начать рассмотрение услуги заново вместо: Restart consideration of the service instead of issuing the completed result
strings.Не заменяет специальную норму: Does not replace a special provision
strings.Немедленное удовлетворение любого требов: Immediate satisfaction of every demand without verification
strings.Необходимо проверить передачу, уведомлен: Transfer, notification and issuance must be checked separately.
strings.Нужно заново направить первоначальный па: The original package must be sent for review again.
strings.Обжалуется бездействие работника окна вы: The complaint concerns the issuing-counter employee's failure to act, not an institutional instruction or the authority's decision.
strings.Обращение рассматривается в пределах ком: An appeal is considered within jurisdiction; any special procedure requires a separate check. General written-reply periods are not the same as deadlines for repairs, benefits or register corrections.

strings.Профиль исчисления этого упражнения: исх: This exercise's calculation profile excludes the starting day and rolls the deadline forward, using the federal five-day working week. It is not a rule for every procedure.
strings.Сведения о другом заявителе, объекте или: Information about another applicant, facility or period does not replace verification in this case. A body's name does not grant an employee unlimited powers.
strings.Сверить наличие подписанного результата: Check that a signed result exists and has been received by the centre
strings.Сначала определите действие, для которог: First identify the action to which the deadline applies. Applying for a service, registering a complaint and resolving a problem are not the same event.
strings.Сообщить заявителю способ получения без: Tell the applicant how to collect the result without requiring withdrawal of the complaint
